outcome: Hemoglobin levels at different time points
cohort: 122 women who underwent uncomplicated elective cesarean section
finding: Routine post-operative hemoglobin assay after uncomplicated elective cesarean sections is not necessary, especially when the pre-operative hemoglobin is ≥ 11 gms%, cesarean section duration is < 45 min, and estimated intra-operative blood loss is ≤ 500 mL.
